# CRIX v1.0.0

Initial release of CRIX, an explainable credit-risk intelligence and decisioning lab.

- Calibrated probability of default with monotonic gradient boosting
- Transparent challenger model and confidence checks
- PD, LGD, EAD and expected-loss modelling
- Interactive underwriting, portfolio, stress-testing and model-diagnostics dashboard
- Self-contained Next.js deployment with no database or external ML inference service required

Thanks for checking it out.
